name: Dun Aengus
kurzbeschreibung: Discover the Magic of Tirol – Where Tradition Meets Adventure Welcome to Tirol, a land of breathtaking alpine landscapes, charming villages, and unforgettable experiences.
beschreibung: The Dun Aengus in Kufstein is a quaint pub with an authentic atmosphere and genuine welcoming warmth. Here, locals and travelers come together to savor the evening over a freshly poured cold beer or a fine spirit. The menu offers traditional pub comfort food and regional Tyrolean delicacies prepared fresh on site. The rustic interior with comfortable wooden seating creates a relaxed mood that invites guests to linger. Whether stopping by for an after-work pint or a lively gathering with friends, Dun Aengus is a premier spot for sociable hours.
